name: get_devices
description:
List devices

Returns a paginated list of the devices of the organization. Results can be filtered by site and by status.

GET /v2/devices

name: get_devices_device_id
post_devices
description:
Create a device

Registers a new device with its serial number and assigns it to a site.

POST /v2/devices

serial.description: Serial number printed on the device

name: patch_devices_device_id
delete_devices_device_id
post_devices_device_id_reboot
description:
Reboot a device

Sends a reboot command to the device. It takes effect at its next contact.

POST /v2/devices/{device_id}/reboot

name: post_devices_device_id_calibrate
description:
Calibrate a device

Starts the calibration of the sensors of a device against a reference value.

POST /v2/devices/{device_id}/calibrate

name: get_devices_device_id_readings
description:
List readings

Returns the measurements a device sent over a time range: temperature, humidity, pressure and the other values of its sensors.

GET /v2/devices/{device_id}/readings

name: get_devices_device_id_firmware
description:
Retrieve firmware status

Returns the firmware version a device runs and whether a newer version is available.

GET /v2/devices/{device_id}/firmware

name: put_devices_device_id_firmware
description:
Update firmware

Schedules the installation of a firmware version on a device.

PUT /v2/devices/{device_id}/firmware

name: get_gateways
description:
List gateways

Returns a paginated list of the gateways that relay the devices of each site to the platform.

GET /v2/gateways

name: get_gateways_gateway_id
post_gateways
description:
Create a gateway

Registers a new gateway on a site.

POST /v2/gateways

name: delete_gateways_gateway_id
get_sites
description:
List sites

Returns a paginated list of the sites of the organization, with their address and number of devices.

GET /v2/sites

name: post_sites
description:
Create a site

Creates a site, a place where devices are installed, with its name, address and time zone.

POST /v2/sites

name: patch_sites_site_id
delete_sites_site_id
get_alerts
description:
List alerts

Returns a paginated list of the alerts raised by the alert rules, open or acknowledged.

GET /v2/alerts

name: post_alerts_alert_id_acknowledge
description:
Acknowledge an alert

Marks an alert as acknowledged, so it stops notifying, with an optional comment.

POST /v2/alerts/{alert_id}/acknowledge

name: delete_alerts_alert_id
get_alert_rules
description:
List alert rules

Returns the rules that raise an alert when a reading crosses a threshold or a device goes silent.

GET /v2/alert-rules

name: post_alert_rules
description:
Create an alert rule

Creates a rule that raises an alert when a measure of a device crosses a threshold for a given time.

POST /v2/alert-rules

duration.description: Seconds above the threshold before the alert is raised

name: patch_alert_rules_rule_id

rule_id.description: The ID of the alert rule

name: delete_alert_rules_rule_id

rule_id.description: The ID of the alert rule

name: get_users
description:
List users

Returns a paginated list of the users of the organization with their role.

GET /v2/users

name: post_users_invitations
description:
Invite a user

Sends an invitation by email to join the organization with a role.

POST /v2/users/invitations

name: patch_users_user_id
delete_users_user_id
get_api_keys
description:
List API keys

Returns the API keys of the organization, with their scopes and when each was last used. The secret is never returned.

GET /v2/api-keys

name: post_api_keys
description:
Create an API key

Creates an API key with the given scopes. The secret is returned once, in this response only.

POST /v2/api-keys

name: delete_api_keys_key_id

key_id.description: The ID of the API key

name: get_webhooks
description:
List webhooks

Returns the webhooks that send events of the platform to an URL.

GET /v2/webhooks

name: post_webhooks
description:
Create a webhook

Creates a webhook that posts the chosen events, such as new alerts, to an URL.

POST /v2/webhooks

name: delete_webhooks_webhook_id
post_webhooks_webhook_id_test
description:
Test a webhook

Sends a sample event to the URL of a webhook and returns the response it got.

POST /v2/webhooks/{webhook_id}/test

name: post_exports
description:
Create an export

Starts an export of the readings of a site or of a device over a time range, as a CSV file.

POST /v2/exports

name: get_exports_export_id
get_audit_events
description:
List audit events

Returns the changes made in the organization: who changed what and when.

GET /v2/audit-events

name: get_usage
description:
Retrieve usage

Returns the usage of the organization for the current billing period: active devices, readings stored and API calls.

GET /v2/usage
